page.layout: One page of text, running head with page number at the top. Main text in one column, with the letter's address block and salutation, then the body. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right, gathering signature at the lower left.

main_text.l: Francisco Cardinali Barberino J. Mo-rinus Congreg.
Orat. Presb. summa cum observantia S. D. P.
quas legens faciem sensi saepius pudore
suffundi, singulis enim fere periodis animo
dem in tenui laborem non impendisse,
neque ut dicitur, ἐπὶ τῇ Φακῇ μωΐεγν
rim à nemine improbatum iri spectavi
conjiciebam; at ab Eminentia tua non
ravi, non conjeci, non cogitavi: quid-
quid de illo honore dicam, quo me tam

page.notes: The Greek phrase after "dicitur," is uncertain and marked [?]; the letters may not be read exactly. The page number "435" is partly faded at the final digit. The drop-cap initial L of "Literas" is printed as a large letter. The "Digitized" watermark at the lower right is excluded.
